note: Ransom County recreation area about 5 miles SE of Lisbon on the Dead Colt Creek reservoir, run by the county water resource district. Two RV loops on the north shore: the West campground by the office and swim beach, and the East campground by the ballfields and boat ramp. Swim beach, fishing, playground, ballfields. No ATVs or dirt bikes in the park; UTVs and golf carts on roads only, licensed drivers. --Claude
summary: Own site + live RoverPass: $22 for every RV class (weekly $154, monthly $385), 48 RV sites in two loops (30-75 ft), 30/50 A + water, showers/dump, reservations required (fcfs never), 14-night cap on short-term sites, season Apr 30 - Oct 1 per engine. Groups written. Lakeview stands (no pad within ~100 m of water). Pin ok. Phone flag.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview stands, not upgraded. No RV pad is within ~100 m of the reservoir: West RV 1-9 (east side of the West loop, ~46.3713,-97.6250) look east across a spruce row and open mown grass to the reservoir's north arm ~110-130 m away (shore fringed with trees); RV 10-18 sit inside the tree-ringed loop. East 31-37 (~46.3730,-97.6150) are ~110 m from the water across the park road, a double shelterbelt and the tent field (sites I-N). The swim beach and pavilion lawn lie between the West loop and the main reservoir. A filtered view from the West loop's east row and the East loop's south row is the most the imagery supports.

LONG-STAY: local (county water resource district), not a private park, but some RV sites take long-term campers ('Campers staying long-term will need to sign long-term camping agreement'). Nightly sale is the main use: 17 RV sites are named short-term only (14-day limit) and 33 RV sites were open for one night on June 8, 2027 (16 'long or short term' + 17 short-term). No wording discourages nightly guests.

SPLIT: two RV loops ~0.9 km apart (West centre ~46.3713,-97.6262, 18 sites; East centre ~46.3735,-97.6151, ~30 sites), both off the same park road along the north shore, one RoverPass listing and one office. Under the ~1 km line and sharing the park entrance road: not proposed as a split.
